name: KGL2DMNClasses
title: Knowledge graph L2DMN: classes
description: The classes of the L2DMN layer of the SMART Guidelines knowledge graph. A node's `type` is one of these. Source: smart-base/L1/schemas/L2-DMN.ts (migrated from smart-kg ontology/L2-DMN/L2-DMN.json).

concept.definition: One DMN file as a unit -- the `dmn:definitions` root. Shares its IRI with the l1:external-artifact for the same file, so the l2:decision-support-logic component that points at it and this subgraph name one resource.
A `dmn:decision` -- the question being answered, and the node that carries the link back to the BPMN task invoking it. A file may hold several; the BCG file holds one.

The table realising a decision. Separate from dmn-decision because DMN permits other expression kinds -- a literal expression, an invocation -- and collapsing the two would make the graph unable to say which was used.
An input column. Its expression text is where data element names are embedded, which is the only reason this is a node rather than a property of the table.

An output column. The BCG table's four are Care Plan, Guidance displayed to health worker, Annotations and Reference(s). These are column DEFINITIONS in a decision table, not clinical records: no edge from this class reaches an execution artefact, and none may.

One row. Its input and output cells are carried as properties, not nodes: 250 of them in the BCG table alone, none the target of a cross-model edge. What the rule needs a node for is its citation edge into L1.
